purposeTaxonomy.promotional: Commercial or new-opportunity ask; a syllabus-plus-fee advert is not substantive teaching.
purposeTaxonomy.mixed: Substantive explanation in the message plus a commercial ask.
purposeTaxonomy.educational: Explains a concept, risk or safety practice with no commercial ask; includes free learning events.
purposeTaxonomy.unclear: Neither explains nor sells: ordinary notes, budgets, reminders, or pretext demands for credentials/release fees.

scopeNote: These39 decisions document review of visible development labels only. They do not relabel held-out messages or claim the current purpose classifier implements this taxonomy completely. Explicit reviewer decisions take precedence over earlier purpose labels only in a separately versioned purpose-development evaluation.
